title: Cardiovascular pre-participation screening of young competitive athletes for prevention of sudden death: proposal for a common European protocol
claims: The 2005 ESC consensus statement proposed a common European protocol for pre-participation cardiovascular screening of young competitive athletes.

Personal history is considered positive in the case of exertional chest pain or discomfort, syncope or near-syncope, irregular heartbeat or palpitations, and shortness of breath or fatigue out of proportion to exertion.
Physical examination includes features suggestive of Marfan syndrome, femoral artery pulses, systolic clicks or murmurs and blood pressure.
The proposed protocol includes a 12-lead ECG.
